replacements.old: Quick fact: Forks, Washington — where the story is set — was almost entirely NOT filmed in Forks. Director Catherine Hardwicke chose Oregon and Washington State locations based on visual fit, not story geography.
replacements.new: Quick fact: Forks, Washington is the story's setting, but much of the first film was shot elsewhere. Oregon Film's production records list Twilight filming across Portland, Oxbow Park, St. Helens, Carver, Ecola State Park, Silver Falls State Park, Estacada, Vernonia, Damascus, the Columbia River Gorge, and Oregon City. urlOregon Film production recordshttps://oregonfilm.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Filmography-CURRENT.pdf
